sets.title: Same printed figure
sets.what: Scan of a book figure, with EntoWing's tracing of that figure in the library (40 wings).

sets.title: Other species, same family
sets.what: Open-licence wing photographs and drawings from recent papers (Zenodo / Plazi) of 30 families that are in the library, but showing other species than the library plates.

sets.title: Families not in the library
sets.what: Wing photographs of 5 families that EntoWing has no plate for; the right answer is “no reliable match”.

reading: The lab reliably finds a drawing that is already in its library. It does not yet identify the family of a new specimen: with one drawing per family, other species of the same family usually look too different. It now says so (no reliable match) much more often instead of naming a wrong family.
